analysis.session_summary: Friday's US employment report printed 29K vs 89K forecast and initially weakened the dollar, but USD selling was rejected: it fell to -0.20% then recovered 90% to rank second at +0.213%. EUR was the weakest major at -0.413%, giving back 87% of an early +0.07% attempt, while AUD led at +0.266% and CAD lagged at -0.283%. Oil-reserve headlines drove risk and commodity FX, with USD/SEK and USD/NOK closing up 0.579% and 0.473% respectively.

themes.theme: Post-NFP dollar dip faded fast, leaving USD resilient despite soft jobs print.
themes.evidence: USD strength_pct 0.213, shape note sold to -0.20% and recovered 90%, DXY +0.455%.

themes.theme: Euro is the clear laggard after muted CPI and failed upside attempt.
themes.evidence: EUR strength_pct -0.413, attempt rejected gave back 87% of early gains, CPI basket moved -0.036%.

themes.theme: Commodity/risk FX divergence: AUD strong, NZD/CAD weak, oil headlines add volatility.
themes.evidence: AUD strength 0.266 vs CAD -0.283 and NZD -0.204, AUD/NZD +0.47%, USD/CAD +0.497%, USD/SEK +0.579%, USD/NOK +0.473%.

currency_drivers.USD: NFP miss briefly weakened it, then selling was rejected and it recovered 90% of losses.
currency_drivers.EUR: CPI beat was muted, basket -0.036%; early +0.07% attempt gave back 87%.
currency_drivers.JPY: No catalyst; held a tight range with modest +0.061% strength.
currency_drivers.GBP: No catalyst; closed at its best, third-strongest at +0.199%.
currency_drivers.AUD: No own catalyst; strongest major at +0.266%, holding gains as risk appetite favored it.
currency_drivers.CAD: No catalyst; fell 0.283% against majors, pressured by oil and risk flows.
currency_drivers.CHF: No catalyst; safe-haven bid kept it firm at +0.161%.
currency_drivers.NZD: No catalyst; soft at -0.204%, lagging AUD despite similar risk profile.

leg_notes.EUR/USD: EUR/USD drifted down -25.8 pips into NFP, popped +57.6 on the miss, then faded -100.3 pips into the close, leaving euro the weakest major.

polarity_reads.read: Normal polarity (USD weaker on miss) but only -0.097% own-currency impulse and 90% recovery suggests market was not positioned for a soft print, limiting sustained USD downside.
Muted polarity with basket -0.036% inside noise floor shows EUR had no bid; euro traders ignored the inflation beat, consistent with weak positioning.

scenarios.name: Soft ISM reignites dollar weakness but EUR underperforms
scenarios.thesis: ISM below 55.1 revives the NFP story, pressuring USD, but euro's own negative momentum caps EUR/USD upside while GBP/AUD lead.
scenarios.invalidation: ISM prints above 55.4 or USD recovery extends beyond DXY 102.149.

pair_paths.rationale: Short covering after EUR laggard, but euro weakness limits move to the size of the prior NFP pop.
The NFP impulse showed USD/JPY falling 46.0 pips in 15 minutes, likely to repeat on soft ISM.

scenarios.name: Strong ISM extends USD recovery
scenarios.thesis: ISM above 55.4 confirms resilient US economy, pushing USD higher and resuming EUR weakness and CAD softness.
scenarios.invalidation: ISM below 55.1 or EUR/USD breaks above 1.11823.

pair_paths.rationale: EUR/USD closed down 70.3 pips on the day; a strong ISM extends the downtrend by a similar amount.
USD/CAD already gained 70.6 pips; oil and CAD weakness can repeat that move.

scenarios.name: ISM in line, consolidation
scenarios.thesis: ISM prints near 55.1 with no fresh catalyst; markets consolidate post-NFP recovery within recent ranges.
scenarios.invalidation: A break of EUR/USD 124.0-pip range or USD/JPY 121.9-pip range.

pair_paths.rationale: EUR/USD range was 124.0 pips; without drivers price stays inside it.
USD/JPY range was 121.9 pips; consolidation within that band is likely.

risks.risk: Oil reserve announcements reverse commodity FX moves
risks.why_it_matters: CAD, NOK, SEK and risk sentiment are sensitive to headline-driven supply narratives, as shown by USD/CAD +0.497% and USD/NOK +0.473%.

risks.risk: Fed repricing after ISM could undo USD recovery
risks.why_it_matters: USD selling was rejected after NFP; a soft ISM could trigger a larger unwind of long USD positions.

risks.risk: EUR short-covering on any USD weakness
risks.why_it_matters: EUR is the weakest major and heavily short; a catalyst could force a sharp squeeze.

analysis.calendar_ahead_note: ISM Services PMI at 16:00 (forecast 55.1 vs previous 55.4) is the key event; a miss can challenge the USD recovery while a beat reinforces it, and any oil headlines will continue to drive CAD, NOK, SEK.
